question: Does action persistence abolish the direction-blind ambitendency/stupor confinement phenotype, and what does it cost on an adequate representation? (2x2: representation quality x k=2 latch)

answer.design: 2x2, representation quality x action persistence, on the SAME k=2 latch operator; confinement scored by the re-posed period-agnostic C1 (GFLAG-0233), competence by foraging_competence and resources_per_100_survived_steps

findings.F1_latch_inert_on_degraded_representatio: On the direction-blind reader the k=2 latch changes nothing that matters: confinement 100 -> 97 pct, competence flat within seed (0.00/0.25/0.55 -> 0.10/0.25/0.50). It does NOT abolish the phenotype; it re-periodises a period-2 cycle to period 2k, which the incumbent period-2 detector could not see.
findings.F2_latch_harmful_on_adequate_representat: On the adequate (local-view) representation the SAME latch creates confinement where there was none (0 -> 73 pct), halves foraging efficiency (29.2 -> 14.3 res/100 survived steps), cuts survival ~4x (164 -> 38 steps) and takes death rate from 0.65 to 1.00. Raw resources/episode falls ~8x, which decomposes into the efficiency and survival terms above.
findings.F3_no_persistence_operator_escapes: No persistence operator tested abolishes confinement on the direction-blind reader: persist_k2 97 pct, persist_k4 77 pct (field-determined lower bound), switch_cost 90 pct. switch_cost is a boundary-press fixed point on 0.55/1.00/1.00 of episodes.
findings.F4_only_perturbation_escapes: The only arms that escape are the non-persistence ones: stochastic_sample (<=3 pct confined, 25.3 mean unique cells, competence 1.70-2.05) and random_walk (<=8 pct, 17.9 unique cells). On this substrate the trap is broken by perturbation, not persistence.
findings.F5_phenotype_is_seed_42_only: The ambitendency two-cycle is a seed-42 phenomenon. Seeds 43 and 44 are 100 pct boundary-press fixed points on every arm, so a criterion posed on 'the cycle' reads 2 of 3 seeds as empty; the confinement criterion reads all three.

answer.bearing_on_MECH-536: MECH-536 registers persistence as PROTECTIVE against representational degradation rather than NECESSARY for competence. The protective half is NOT supported here: the latch confers no competence benefit on the degraded representation (flat within seed) and is actively costly on the adequate one. The 'not necessary' half IS supported: local_view_greedy forages 45.75-49.70 res/ep with no persistence at all. MECH-536's own premise sentence -- 'Any persistence of >=2 steps on the chosen action escapes a two-cycle trivially' -- is true of the period-2 SIGNATURE and false of the TRAP, and that is the sentence that propagated into the unfailable C1.
answer.bearing_on_MECH-535: Untouched in direction. The record reinforces MECH-535's own title: the two phenotypes (approach/withdraw limit cycle and boundary-press fixed point) are one confinement phenomenon selected by initial condition, and a single period-agnostic measure covers both.
answer.admissibility_caveat: The adequate-representation half of the 2x2 rests on ANCHOR arms (local_view_greedy, local_view_greedy_persist_k2) recorded in anchor_results, not on scored eval_results arms. Governance should decide whether an anchor-vs-anchor contrast is admissible as claim evidence, or whether a confirmatory run promoting these two cells to scored eval arms is wanted. This reanalysis does not assume the former.
answer.method_caveat: Confinement is scored two ways that agree on every arm: (a) field-determined over all 60 episodes/arm from the recorded per_episode fields (fixed_point OR orbit_period is not None -> confined), which is CONSERVATIVE (it can only positively detect confinement, never escape); and (b) the re-posed position-level C1 over the 6 episodes/arm that carry positions in the episode log. The confined_pct figures above are the conservative (a) lower bounds.

method_note: Re-scored V3-EXQ-1007's banked manifest and episode log under the re-posed period-agnostic confinement criterion (GFLAG-0233; design record evidence/planning/mech536_c1_reposed_confinement_criterion_20260911.md). Confinement determined two ways -- conservatively from recorded per_episode fields over all 60 eps/arm, and at position level over the 6 eps/arm carrying positions -- which agree on every arm.
